guitar.notes: Steve Miller is well known for playing custom Fender Stratocasters extensively throughout his career.

tone.target: bright jangly crunch with rhythmic wah
tone.profile: bright jangly crunch with rhythmic wah
tone.summary: A clean/crunch foundation using the US Deluxe or UK 45 model, followed by a Wah pedal for rhythmic texture. The signal chain is kept relatively dry with minimal modulation to achieve a tight, jangly 70s rock sound.
corrections: lean less blues, more classic rock jangle

rig.name: Steve Miller Band - Rock'n Me - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
